$Comment: The first rung of Marn's Edge, the questline that ends with Marn's own hatchet: plain stock in
It opens once A Finer Edge is claimed, so it is only ever offered to a woodcutter who has
finished the sawmill chain and owns a well-run mill. mill_stock counts every cut of every
species the Sawmill hands over ('Wood_' on PREFIX, qualified to the Sawmill, so lumber from a
hand bench does not count) and carries the shared mill_lumber TextKey, since the kind's default
line names a single item; run_cycles is WORK_STATION on the station id, as the station's own
asset spells it, and counts real cycles only, so idle practice with nothing loaded does not
tick. Both sit on Order 1 and fill through the same shift. deliver_stock is Order 2, a hand-in
to Marn only (TurnInNpcId 'giver') that matches any species and any half-plank cut on CONTAINS,
so the shift that fills the first two steps also stocks the third.
Rewards sit in Claim: Woodcutting XP, with a smaller Crafting cut for the milling itself. The
Chains entry files it as tier 1 of marns_edge, its own ladder in the quest book beside the
sawmill chain it follows. Raise or lower the three Amounts together to change how long the
rung takes; the shift and the delivery are sized so one fills the other.
Name: Straight_Grain
